answer_3.quote: To systematically classify them, we use Mixtral-8x22B-v0.1 LLM, which evaluates each generated query and determines whether it is suitable as retrieval query

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. We randomly sampled 500 queries from Vidore, MMLong-Bench, and our benchmark. Annotators, unaware of the source benchmark or study goal, evaluated whether each query could reasonably be asked by a real user
